original_test_intent: Verify a fully populated system survives ten abrupt AC removals after five minutes of CPU/DIMM/storage stress at 40C and -5% 5V/3.3V rails, logs each power loss and restores all devices and services.
original_method: Freeze full device and storage-target identity, select non-destructive or owner-approved disposable stress, establish the exact five-minute steady-state condition, use a rated interlocked AC fixture with defined removal/reapply dwell and auto-power behavior, perform ten supervised drops at controlled margin, and after each reapply capture BMC/OS readiness, expected power-loss events, storage integrity and full inventory before the next cycle; abort on fault and restore nominal conditions.
manual_activity: Operator establishes full load and negative margin, triggers ten physical AC drops, observes recovery and restores the platform.
required_inputs: Safe stress tools and immutable storage targets with backup/exclusion proof
Five-minute load floors and steady-state definition
AC fixture/feed rating, drop/reapply dwell and auto-power policy
Expected power-loss log signatures and per-cycle readiness limits
safety_requirements: Use interlocked mains equipment rated for load and inrush
Protect boot and non-disposable storage from undefined writes
Do not erase historical logs or silently repeat a failed drop
Abort on unsafe electrical, thermal, storage or repeated readiness fault
Restore rails/chamber and validate data before service
agent_execution_scope: May analyze per-cycle inventory, workload, integrity and log artifacts
Must not choose storage targets, interrupt AC or assign verdict
engineer_actions: Approve load/targets, fixture timing and expected event policy
Supervise ten drops and fault handling

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects remote-only execution; manual cable removal should be replaced by or bounded through an approved fixture and explicit timing.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Operator initiates approved stress, confirms five-minute steady state, then performs each interlocked AC drop/reapply sequence without automatic retry.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Full population, CPU/DIMM/HDD stress for five minutes, ten AC drops, 40C and -5% rails are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a ten-entry fault-injection ledger linking pre-drop load state, fixture transition, expected events, data integrity and full-device recovery.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds safe target selection, steady-state proof, controlled fixture/dwell, expected power-loss allowlist and per-cycle integrity.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Graceful cycling or unloaded drops cannot substitute for abrupt removal during active CPU/memory/storage work.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Abrupt loss can corrupt data and produce expected logs; without a defined event and integrity oracle, expected faults may be mislabeled or real failures ignored.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines disposable storage scope, expected AC-loss events, persistence of application data and whether any single incomplete recovery terminates the test.
expected_evidence: Full device and safe storage-target inventory
Stress configuration and five-minute steady-state metrics per drop
Fixture/feed identity and calibrated chamber/rail trace
Ten drop/reapply timestamps and readiness results
Per-cycle data integrity/device inventory and final nominal health

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Stability row29 Wistron-Margin-00028-V002: approve full device inventory and safe CPU/DIMM/storage stress/targets, five-minute steady-state rule, AC-drop fixture/feed/drop-reapply dwell/auto-power policy, 40C/-5% tolerances, expected power-loss logs, per-cycle readiness/inventory/data-integrity oracle, abort/OOB and restoration.

review_improvement: Makes abrupt loaded power loss distinguishable from ordinary cycling and protects storage while preserving expected-versus-unexpected event evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: The key exposure occurs when AC disappears during active storage writes and high current demand. Five elapsed minutes alone does not prove steady state, and a recovered OS does not prove storage integrity or complete device enumeration. Each drop therefore needs correlated load, power, log and data evidence.
